summary: DevOps engineer with 7 years of experience building and operating banking, SaaS, and AI products end to end, from architecture to day-to-day operation. Expertise in **CI/CD pipelines**, **Terraform**, **Docker**, **GitHub Actions**, **AWS and GCP**, and **automation**.

bullets: Ran **CI** on **AWS ECS** containers and separated a social media AI tool into local, staging and production environments.
Implemented cloud **OIDC** sign-in so developers get short-lived credentials from the CLI, avoiding shared long-lived keys.
Built **TypeScript** scripts and **GitHub Actions** workflows to automate GitHub and Vercel team membership.
Deployed internal applications with **Docker** and managed secrets with **HashiCorp Vault** and **AWS Secrets Manager**.
Developed **infrastructure as code** with security in mind, setting up DNS and communication between services.
Deployed and operated on-premise and self-hosted services, handling configuration, networking, monitoring, and maintenance.
Built and managed **AWS** resources (EC2, S3, IAM) and **GCP** resources to host internal services and engineering workflows.
Built internal developer tools and **AI tools** integrating **LLMs**, using health checks and email alerts for observability.

Led two **production systems**—a call analysis SaaS platform and a trading card marketplace API—owning architecture, backend, frontend, and cloud infrastructure from design through deployment and day-to-day operation, using **Claude Code**.
Managed **cloud services on GCP** with **Terraform** and **CI/CD pipelines**, including automated testing and monitoring.
Provisioned GCP resources (Cloud Run, MySQL, Pub/Sub, secrets) with **Terraform** and migrated CI pipelines to **IaC**.
Automated **Docker** builds and **GitHub Actions** deployment workflows, with secrets in **GCP Secret Manager**.
Monitored production with uptime and health checks, email and Slack alerts, and responded to incidents.
Separated both systems into local, staging and production environments with **OIDC** CLI sign-in for non-production access.
Built **AI-driven transcription and insight pipelines** with **LLM** prompts; acted as **product owner**.
Stored application secrets in **GCP Secret Manager** per environment and kept production healthy with Docker-based deployments.
Managed **GitLab** repositories and **CI/CD pipelines** for internal tools.
Collaborated with leadership to design and automate the HR system infrastructure, eliminating tens of hours of weekly reporting.
Developed reusable **internal tools** and libraries with standardized interfaces, streamlining development and reducing boilerplate.
Built secure login for a cross-platform mobile banking app—challenge authentication, OTP login, and **session management**.
Rebuilt legacy banking **REST API** services and modernized legacy browser and mobile banking apps with **Angular/Ionic** and **Express**.
Established test environments and wrote **unit** and **end-to-end** tests to meet the banking client's **90% test coverage** requirement.
**Saved QA teams hundreds of hours weekly** with **Python** scripts that parse phone IVR banking logs, replacing manual searches.
Built a **reusable global component library** in **Storybook** with UI designers, improving consistency across banking applications.
Provided **technical leadership** through training and developer support, working in **Agile** teams across client engagements.
Open source maintainer of **20 applications**, **6 API services**, **12 Docker images** and **4 npm packages**.
Build and maintain **GitHub Actions** **CI/CD pipelines** for PR checks, deployments, npm publishing, backups and secret rotation.
Provision multi-cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Cloudflare) with **Terraform**, **Ansible** and **Bash**, with daily drift detection.
Maintain operational checks in CI: health checks, cron jobs, and smoke, end-to-end, and security tests.
Run nightly backups with weekly restore tests, and hourly uptime checks with a public status page.
Self-host **Gitea**, **RabbitMQ**, Grafana and Loki on **Linux** hosts, with **Cloudflare** Tunnels and Access.
